testProvenance.ordinaryFlows: Three public-controller model flows perform actual same-cell/same-nozzle double watering, free nozzle switches and final-drop wins. Additional ordinary input cases cover all four corner nozzles, center preview, fixed actual lastWater after selection/mode change, closed-even/open-odd marked cells,9O,10E water loss and90s timeout.
testProvenance.patternOnly: A copy of public facts is supplied to the independent public solver with marked conditions removed solely to search for a deliberately insufficient flower-only plan (bounded262144 candidates). The returned three diagonal actions are replayed on an untouched real level1 model:16/16flowers but3/4marks, phaseplaying. This is ordinary model-state evidence, not a forced outcome.
testProvenance.tenEvenFixture: The real10th authored drop exhausts water and opens the result overlay. A separate named legibility fixture extends waterBudget to12 and executes10 ordinary same-nozzle sprays to expose10E in the full960/1280 UI. It is not normal authored-budget gameplay or a victory.
testProvenance.runtimeLayouts: Menu/start/pause use ordinary browser keys. Nine copied-state fixtures per viewport replace create only in the scratch HTTP response. These are explicit layout snapshots, not browser-earned full wins. No APK/video/device claim.
testProvenance.readOnly: Deeply frozen states render unchanged. Throwing getters on every private model field, plus changed external clock/raw inputs, yield identical render commands, HUD and result text.
testProvenance.history: Early images retain the original source hashes and a false final-provenance status because the unused pilot file was being edited concurrently. The incomplete2d8df full pass exposed a1280 won-result orphan. Neither attempt is reused as passing evidence: all34 final render cases and both-viewport layouts were rerun on678707 with stable89acd pilot.

independentStaticReview.scope: Read-only contract/game/icon source review. No browser or model-runtime claim by that reviewer.
resolvedFindings: Tip now explicitly requires the same cell AND the same nozzle for two sprays to restore flower pattern.
Actual screenshots confirm the target bud silhouette and main-cell direct badges remain distinct/readable despite lower foliage underlays.

findings: Filled warm open petals and compact cool buds with hollow outlines remain distinct in the target40px grid and live78px grid.
Marked status uses both open and even: closed0E and open1O are visibly unsatisfied. Zero-even is explicitly stated.
The genuine flower-only target counterexample shows16/16 but3/4 and continues playing, with the unmet marked cell selected.
Full-page960 shows9O and the explicitly labelled12-budget10E fixture; the counts are readable and no numeral is clipped.
Corner diagonal preview shows two legal tiles and cross shows three, without wrap. The mini-map omits out-of-board cells.
The final short win explanation is single-line at960 and1280. Menu/pause/win/water/timeout, glass overlay and entire sidebar fit; no terminal action prompt remains on canvas.
